name: io.github.stonefrozen096-collab/red-design-mcp
title: Red Design MCP
description: Analyze, recreate and audit designs: tokens, palettes, WCAG contrast, CSS lint, design systems.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Anthropic API key. Optional: any provider key switches vision tools from host mode (your AI tool looks at images) to API mode.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key. Optional, used for the vision tools in API mode.

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Google Gemini API key (GOOGLE_API_KEY also works). Optional, used for the vision tools in API mode.

environmentVariables.name: GROQ_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Groq API key. Optional, used for the vision tools in API mode.

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenRouter API key. Optional, used for the vision tools in API mode.

environmentVariables.name: RED_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Force one provider when several keys are set. Default: first key found in the order anthropic, openai, google, groq, openrouter.

environmentVariables.name: RED_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Override the model name used in API mode, for example claude-opus-5-5.

environmentVariables.name: RED_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, such as Ollama at http://localhost:11434/v1. Also set RED_MODEL.

environmentVariables.name: RED_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint, if it needs one.

environmentVariables.name: RED_MAX_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum reply length for vision calls. Default 16000.

environmentVariables.name: RED_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Which tools to load: groups core, vision, web, color, system, components, quality, or tool names. Combine with commas, exclude with a dash, add auto to let the AI discover tools on demand. Default: all.

environmentVariables.name: RED_ALLOW_PRIVATE_URLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to let tools fetch or capture localhost and private-network addresses. Blocked by default for safety.

environmentVariables.name: RED_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Optional folders images may be read from, separated by the OS path separator (: on Mac and Linux, ; on Windows). Unset allows any folder, but only real image files are ever read.
